tei:div.tei:p: (āḥ)༄༅// thun mong ma yin pa'i bsam mi khyab kyi rnal 'byor mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i nye lam bzhugs so// ༈ /rje btsun bla ma mus pa chen po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// rjes su bzung du gsol/ thun mong ma yin pa'i bsam mi khyab kyi rnal 'byor ni/ bzlas pa gnyis grub rjes chos 'byung bam̐ yig sogs ni nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba bzhin gyur/ rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma phyi bltas nang gsal nang bltas phyi gsal/ kha dog dmar po nam mkha' la 'ja' shar ba bzhin snang la rang bzhin med par bsam pa'i/ lus kyi dbus nas yar rtsa dbu ma chos bzhi ldan rta rnga ltar phra ba/ rgya skyegs ltar dmar ba/ chu shing ltar drang ba/ til mar ltar gsal ba/ yas sna smin mtshams gnad kyi sgo nas spyi gtsug la byas/ mas sna lte ba'i 'khor lo la mtheb sor tsam ma reg pa/ g.yas su ro ma dmar mo gro sog tsam pa yas sna sna bug g.yas nas spyi bo la byas/ mas sna dbu ma las mtheb tsam gyis ring ba/ g.yon rkyang ma la yang des 'gre lte ba'i rtsa 'khor gyi dbus na bzhugs pa'i bam̐ yig de/ rnal 'byor ma rgyan cha lugs/ thugs kar chos 'byung bam̐ yig sogs dkyus bzhin la/ zhabs gnyis gshibs te brkyang ba'i dbu ma spyi bo la zug pa/ ro rkyang gnyis sku'i g.yas g.yon nas zhabs kyi mthil du zug par bsam/ de nas rang sems dang rje btsun ma bam̐ yig dbyer med pa'i ngo bo lte ba'i rje btsun ma'i thugs ka'i bam̐ yig la sems cher gtad pas/ de nas rje btsun ma'i sku che chung me stag lta bu'i rnam pa can chad/ sku lus g.yas phyogs nas zhabs g.yas pa'i nang nas mar song*/ ro ma'i sne mo zhabs mthil du zug pa la zhugs/ ro ma'i nang nas yar bya gnam 'phang bskyod pa bzhin gyen du song*/ sna g.yas nas bung ba tshang nas 'thon pa bzhin 'thon/ de las de 'dra ba'i rnal 'byor ma'i sku che chung bsam gyis mi khyab pa phyogs thams cad du khyab/ 'phags pa rnams la dgyes pa'i mchod pa/

sems can thams cad rnal 'byor mar gyur pa sogs mdor na snod bcud thams cad dag pa'i rang bzhin du byas/ 'od zer gyi rnam pas tshur bsdus/ sna bug g.yon rkyang ma'i lam brgyud rim gyis song bas/ zhabs kyi mthil nas yar byon/ rje btsun ma'i bam̐ yig la thim/ de lta bu rlung 'gro 'ong dang bstun pa'am/ mi bstun yang lan ci mang sbyang*/ ma mtha' yang gsum tsam/ de nas bam̐ yig la sems cher gtad pas/ de las 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ rang rje btsun mar gsal ba'i sku'i smad kyi cha la phog pas/ 'od kyi rnam pas rje btsun ma'i sku'i phyogs la yar 'dus/ de bzhin du stod la song bas mar 'dus/ 'od dmar po rdza ma tsam du gyur/ de yang rje btsun ma la thim/ de nas rje btsun ma de nyid snying ga'i thad du spar gyis byon pas ro rkyang gnyis kyang 'dus te/ zhabs la cung zad nar yod pa tsam/ de nas mgrin pa'i thad du spar gyis byon/ ro rkyang gnyis kyang lhag ma ma lus par 'dus/ de man chad kyi dbu ma'ang sku ji ltar yar byon pa ltar 'dus/ de nas spyi bo'i thad du byon pas/ dbu ma'ang 'dus te rje btsun ma'i sku gcig po rang sems dang dbyer med/ spyan gsum dag pa mkha' spyod du gzigs shing*/ der 'gro ba'i bzhed pa drag po dang ldan pas/ spyan gsum gzigs lugs thugs kyi bzhed pa'i dmigs pa 'di/ snying ga mgrin pa/ lte ba gsum la'ang dgos rgyu yin/ de dang de'i skabs su de dang de la sems gtad nas cung zad re 'jog go /de nas rje btsun ma mkha' spyod du gshegs pa ste je mtho nas yal ba bzhin gyis spros med la ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag de la mi gnas na/ mkha' spyod nas rje btsun ma slar rang nyid 'dug pa'i thad du byon/ de'i rkyen gyis ro rkyang dbu ma rje btsun ma yang gsal btab/ sngar bzhin gyi dmigs pa rnams bya/ de 'dra ba lan ci mang bya'o// 'di la mkha' spyod bsgrub pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams pa/

nang gi rnal 'byor ma mkha' spyod kyi 'pho ba zhes bzhed do// zhes pa 'di'ang sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis bla ma gong ma'i gsung rgyun zin bris rnams la legs par bsdus te brjed thor bris pa'o// 'di'i lung brgyud ni/ mus chen nas/ khri chen yab sras zhwa lu mkhan chen/ bsod nams mchog grub/ mtshungs med kun dga' tshul khrims rgya mtsho/ des bdag la'o// ༈ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i man ngag zab mo gser chos chig brgyud ma bzhugs so// ༈ /nang gi rnal 'byor ma ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ rtsa gsum gsal btab pa/ lus gnad sogs sngar bzhin byas pa'i rtsa dbu ma'i mas sna ru/ bam̐ gyi ngo bo rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mthe bong gi tshad tsam mngon rtogs ji lta ba bzhin gsal btab/ der mar me gcig la gnyis chad kyi tshul gyis/ ro ma'i nang na yar byon/ sna bug g.yas nas 'thon/ snod bcud thams cad sbyangs/ tshur sna bug g.yon nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la thim/ yang sna bug g.yas g.yon nas spro bsdu sogs bya/ sna bug g.yon pa nas zhugs/ sngar ltar rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la thim/ de 'dra ba lan 'ga' re bya/ de nas ro ma zhabs g.yas pa la thim/ rkyang ma zhabs g.yon pa la thim/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dbu ma'i nang nas yar byon pas rtsa dbu ma yang thung du song*/ spyi gtsug tshangs sgo ru slebs/ mthar chos kyi dbyings su yal/ de'i ngang la sems mnyam par bzhag rdo rje phag mo 'grub gyur nas// zhes sogs dang*/ bskyed rim rab tu brtan pa dang*// zhes sogs sh+lau ka gcig dang*/ rdzogs rim rtags rnams myur gsal zhing*// zhes sogs sh+lau ka gcig lha mo tshad ma zhes sogs sh+lau ka gcig srid pa gsum 'bar sogs sh+lau ka gcig bkra shis gang zhig sogs sh+lau ka gcig dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dag gis// zhes sogs dang*/ tshams rngam sngags kyis bsrung ba sogs mdzad cing*/ bla ma'i phyag len mthong ba la'ang shes par bya'o// gsung 'di rnams bla ma'i gsung la/

snga ma'i steng du len pa'i rnal 'byor pa la phan pas zur cig bris pa dge'o// maṅga laṃ/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i man ngag 'di rje btsun mus chen la sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis thob pa'o// ༈ /nā ro mkha' spyod kyi gser chos tshig brgyud ma mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i man ngag sogs zhal shes khag che ba 'ga' zhig sa lo chen po'i phyag dpe las logs su bkod pa bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo gu ru bud+dha dha dza ḍā ki ye/ 'dir sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i phyag dpe mkha' spyod ma'i man ngag zab bsdus shig gi khrod nas bsam mi khyab thun mong ma yin pa sogs zhal shes kyi man ngag khag che ba 'ga' zhig 'dug pa de rnams 'dir bri bar bya'o// de yang sa lo 'jam dbyangs chen po'i phyag dpe de nyid las 'di ltar 'byung ste/ na mā+o shrī badz+ra yo gi nī ye/ rje btsun nā ro pa'i lugs kyi mkha' spyod ma'i sgrub thabs la/ zhal las brgyud pa'i man ngag gsum las/ dang po tshogs zhing skabs su/ mdun du rtsa ba'i bla ma gsung rdo rje'i rnam pa can zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa la brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dmar po ḍā ma ru dang*/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang thod pa 'dzin pa bsgom pa ni/ bla ma'i gsung gis slob ma'i rgyud la phan thogs pa'i rten 'brel yin gsung*/ rdzogs rim dus sems lte bar bstim zhes par tshogs zhing dus bsgom pa'i lte ba'i bam̐ yig la'o// thun 'jog dus su lus gnad dang ldan pas rang gi lus kyi rtsa dbu ma chos bzhi ldan/ g.yas su ro ma me'i rang bzhin dmar po/ g.yon du rkyang ma chu'i rang bzhin dkar po bsgoms la rtsa dbu ma'i mas sne lte bar zug pa'o// lte bar rje btsun ma mthe bong tsam zhig bsams la/ de las de 'dra ba zhig g.yas ro ma nas yar hril li li byon/ sna bug g.yas nas 'thon nam mkha'i mthar gtugs pa'i sems can gyi don byas/ slar byon nas sna bug g.yon nas g.yon rkyang ma nas zhugs te/

lte bar thim pa la rlung bzung*/ yang lte ba'i rje btsun ma las de 'dra ba byung ste g.yas ro ma nas thon pa sogs sngar bzhin mang du byas la/ mthar lte bar rje btsun ma de'i zhabs g.yas g.yon gyis ro rkyang gnyis la reg pas/ zhabs kyis ro rkyang gnyis bsdus te rje btsun ma dbu ma'i nang du yar yar byon pas/ ro rkyang gnyis kyang dbu mar rim rim zhugs/ mthar cha'i gzugs su gyur nas dbu mar rtsa gnyis zhugs/ dbu ma yang je thung je thung la song bar bsams la/ sngar gyi rje btsun ma'i sku de mkha' spyod du byon par bsam la smon lam bya'o// rje btsun ma'i zhal gdams bla ma sa skya pa'i man ngag*/ ༈ /yang sa lo 'jam dbyangs chen po'i phyag dpe de nyid kyi khrod na/ bsam mi khyab thun mong ma yin pa bsgom tshul cung zad mi 'dra ba 'di ltar yang bzhugs te/ ro rkyang gsum skya ram pa la dbu ma cung zad sngo skya'o// dbu ma'i dbus su mkha' 'gro ma mthe bong tsam/ de'i zhabs mthil gnyis la ro rkyang gi mas sna gnyis 'byar ba/ rnal 'byor ma'i sku las sku dpag tu med pa khrig khrig byung nas sems can thams cad rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang la bkod/ de g.yon nas zhugs/ 'og ma la thim/ bskor ba gsum mam lnga sogs byas nas/ mthar sku yar yar byon pas ro rkyang gi yas sna mas sna thams cad snying kha'i rnal 'byor ma'i sku dang gcig tu 'dril nas sna g.yon nas thon nas mdun du bsams nas/ 'chi tshe sogs bya'o// mas yar snying ga'i bar 'dra/ spyi bo tshangs bug thog khung 'dra/ sku zab thal la thon par bsgom/ thun re re las mi dgos so// sna g.yon nas rig 'dzin gyi skye ba 'grub/ phyir rlung gnyis g.yo/ khyad par thig le dwangs ma'i dbus// rnal 'byor dbang phyug sa skya pa// bla ma brgyud pa kha re dang*// yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dang*// phyag rgya'i tshogs dang mchod rten dang*// bu bzhin skyong ba'i dam can sogs// lar nang gcig gi mthong snang bsam mi khyab// ces gsung*/

khyad par zhes pa spyir mang du 'byung bar 'dug gsungs so// 'di'i thang ka yod do// rdo rje 'chang gis shar ba las gsan/ des dpal ldan tshul khrims/ des chos rje bla ma sogs gong ma'i yin/ zhes sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa'i phyag dpe'i khrod na bzhugs pa'i nā ro mkha' spyod kyi bsam mi khyab thun mong ma yin pa'i sgom tshul sogs kyi zhal shes logs su bkod pa 'di yang rje btsun mus pa chen po'i gsung las skyes pa'i sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis man ngag 'di la dad gus kyi dbang gis mkha' spyod dpal gyi pho brang du sug bris su bgyis pa'o// nang gi phag mos gzung 'dzin 'khril shing bcom// mchog gi dhū tīr zhugs pa'i gar mkhan ma// tshangs pa'i sgo nas sprin lam dbyings su 'thon// khrag 'thung dpa' bor 'khyud cing rol par shog /ces gsungs pa'i nyams len 'di 'dra dang 'phrad pa bla ma'i thugs rje yin nges so// nyams len 'di'i gnad shes na/ tshe 'di dang mkha' spyod la dar tsam las med nges par mchis so// dga' 'o skyid do bsam pa 'grub/ sarba maṅga laṃ/ 'di mkha' spyod ma'i nyams len snying po'i don bsdus yin/ rang nyid rtsa gsum lte ba'i mkha' spyod gsal// spros khyab sbyangs gyur 'dus zhugs lte bar thim// de nas lte ba'i dga' ma mkha' spyod ma// 'byon par chas te spyan gsum steng phyogs gzigs// lus 'od zhu zhing steng phyogs rgyang rgyang byon// rtsa gsum thim zhing lus 'od smad nas thim// de nas dga' ma je mtho mkha' spyod byon// slar yang mkha' dbyings nas bab sngar ltar gyur// ka l+yā ṇa bha war+dhan+tu// ༈ /laṅka li ya'i bsgrub pa bya tshul bklags chog ma bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo gu ru bud+dha dh+wa dza ye/ bla ma dang rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo// laṅka li ya'i bsgrub pa ni/ dang por oṃ gsum ma yi ge'i grangs kyi bsnyen pa 'bum phrag gnyis sam gsum ma mtha' dang rab 'bum phrag sum cu rtsa drug gi gzhi yi bsnyen pa mthar phyin par byas/

'jigs su rung ba'i dur khrod dang khad nye ba'i dben pa'i gnas mchog tu/ dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod la dgos pa'i yo byad/ sba'i dbyug pa lag pa gnyis snying khar rtse sprad pa'i gru mo phan tshun gyi rtse dang mnyam pa gcig laṅka li ya zhes pa bal po nas 'byung ba'i shing sbubs can zhig yod pa 'byor na rab/ ma 'byor na do rgod pa'i rkang la rung bar bshad pas de sogs/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i yo byad rnams dang*/ rang grogs dang bcas pas 'tsho ba'i cha rkyen sogs ma tshang ba med pa bsgrubs/ gza' skar dus tshes bzang po la mtshams dam par bcad/ dkyil 'khor gsum bdag 'jug bzhin du/ mchod gtor yang gang shom bshams/ mdun bskyed yan lag bzhi rdzogs su sgrub/ mchod bstod/ mdun bskyed spro bsdu sogs kyi sgo nas/ zhag re la thun bzhir bcad de bzlas par bya/ thun re'i mjug tu mdun bskyed kyi ye shes pa gshegs gsol dang*/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu bar bya/ sin+dhu ra mang po yod na thun re spo/ med na zhag re la thengs re spo/ spos pa'i sin+dhu ra snod bzang por bsog de dkyil 'khor gsar du bshams pa'i 'og tu bzhag de lta bu'i sgo nas 'bum phrag bzhi'i bsnyen pa yid ches par byas/ de grub tshe sba dbyug gu gul gyis bdug bdud rtsi ril bu btab pa'i chang gis byugs/ bde mchog tu bskyed/ grogs 'khor lo sdom pa'i nye snying gi bsnyen pa 'bum phrag bzhi song ba gcig btsal la/ lag tu bzung du bcug sum+bha ni bzlar gzhug rang rje btsun ma'i nga rgyal brtan pos/ laṅka li ya mdzub gang gi tshad tsam gang 'os kyi rtsa ba phyogs su/ sbubs yang dog dang bstun pa'i shing srab mo dga' ba 'khyil pa'i spar/ rang gi dpral bar btab tshe g.yon skor du yod pa brkos/ des 'grig par bgad de yang shog bu lta bus bstums/ kha chod kyang 'grig par bshams/ rang gi lag par bzung*/ gu gul gyis bdug ched du gtad pa'i dmigs pa ni cang mi gsungs la/

oṃ gsum ma brgya rtsa tsam bzlas/ sngar bsags pa'i sin+dhu ra rnams ma zegs par blug kha chod rgyab/ la cha lta bus kyang bsdoms/ de nas yar gyi tshes bcu la mchod bstod dang bdag 'jug kyang shin tu rgyas par byas/ srod kyi dus su zla bo dang 'grogs te/ dbyug pa dang sin+dhu ras dgang ba'i shing khyer/ dur khrod du phyin/ yid la 'bab pa'i sar sa khru gang tsam brus/ sin+dhu ra bcug la sas mnan/ gzhan gyis mi shes shing*/ rang nyid mi 'khrul pa'i rtags nges par byas/ rang nyid de'i steng du 'dug nas bskyed rim bzlas pa/ thun mong ma yin pa'i mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i gdams pa rnams la 'bad/ grogs kyis dbyug pa bzung*/ bar chad bsrung phyir sum+bha ni bzlas/ srod yol yol gyi bar tsam bsdad/ de nas slar sgrub khang du log dbyug pa khyer nas yong*/ sin+dhu ra ni bzhag dgos rgyu'o// de lta bu bcu nas bco lnga la thug gi bar du bya/ bco lnga nas nyi shu'i bar du mtshan gsum cha gcig tsam/ nyi shu'i nyer bzhi'i bar du mtshan gsum gnyis tsam/ nyer lnga'i nub mtshan thog thag bya/ de ltar byas pa'i rtags sin+dhu ra 'phar te 'byung ba dang*/ 'og tu dur khrod sogs kyi skad du ma sgrogs pa dang*/ 'ja' 'od dang lha rdzas kyi spos dri/ rol mo'i sgra sogs 'byung*/ de bzhin ma byung na yang*/ skya rengs dang po shar tshe bton la/ sgrub khang du log sin+dhu ra'i maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du btsugs/ sgrub mchod rgyas pa gcig byas/ nyi ma shar ba na zhabs kyi shog bu bsal/ dga' 'khyil gyi spar dpral bar btab/ grogs bzhag rang nyid kyi bde ba'i cha lugs su byas sin+dhu ra mchan khung g.yon du mis mi mthong bar sbas/ dbyug pa lag tu thogs te/ rgyal khams nyul la/ lhag par bud med gang mang gi sar phyin/ rnal 'byor ma'i bskyed rim la gnas pa'i sgo nas/ de dag la bltas pas dpral ba'i dga' 'khyil gyi gzugs brnyan gang gi dpral bar 'phos pa'i bud med de ni/

rnal 'byor ma yin nges pas/ the tshom spangs te g.yon bskor ba byed pa/ zhabs spyi bor len pa/ ci mnyes sgrub pa'i sgo nas gsol ba btab pa/ des dag pa mkha' spyod du khrid par 'gyur ro// zhes pa 'di yang rje btsun bla ma rnams las man ngag thob pa'i dus/ yid la zin pa khag che ba rnams rang dang rang gi bu slob skal bzang don gnyer can rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ rje btsun gong ma'i gsung rgyun zin bris rnams la slar yang zhib tu bltas nas bzhi thog bla brang gi mkha' spyod dpal gyi pho brang dang 'dab nye bar sbyar ba'o// 'di dam tshig dang mi ldan pa rnams la shin tu gsang ngo*/ sarba maṅga laṃ/ shu bha mastu sarba dzā ga taṃ// ༈ /ngor chen rdo rje'i 'chang gi phyag dpe'i khrod nas rnyed pa'i nā ro mkha' spyod kyi bsam mi khyab thun mong ma yin pa'i yig rnying yid ches can bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo badz+ra yo gi nī ye/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bsgom pa'i gang zag gis thun 'jog dus/ lus gnad dang ldan pas/ rang gi lus kyi dbus su dbu ma chos bzhi ldan/ g.yas su ro ma me yi rang bzhin dmar po/ g.yon rkyang ma chu'i rang bzhin dkar po bsgom la rtsa gsum po'i mas sna lte bar zug pa'o// lte bar rje btsun ma mthe bong tsam zhig bsams la/ de las de 'dra ba gcig

'di na gnyis yod pa 'dra zhig 'dug ste gcig pu de ka yar 'gro mar 'gro skor log byed pa yin gsungs/ g.yas ro ma nas dmar hril li li byon sna bug g.yas nas 'thon/ nam mkha'i mthar thug pa'i sems can gyi don byas don byed lugs sku gcig pu de las mang po 'phros/ sems can thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang la bkod slar byon nas don byed mkhan dang byas pa thams cad sku gcig tu gyur nas sna bug g.yon nas zhugs/ sna bug g.yon nas g.yon rkyang ma nar zhugs/ yang lte ba'i rje btsun ma las de 'dra ba gyur te/ g.yas ro ma nas 'thon pa sogs sngar bzhin mang du byas la/ mthar lte ba'i rje btsun ma de'i zhabs g.yas g.yon gyis ro rkyang gnyis la reg pas/ zhabs kyis ro rkyang gnyis bskul te/ rje btsun ma dbu ma'i nang du yar yar byon pas ro rkyang gnyis kyang dbu mar rim rim zhugs/ mthar cha'i gzugs su gyur nas dbu mar rtsa gnyis zhugs/ dbu ma yang je thung je thung la song bar bsam la/ sngar gyi rje btsun ma'i sku de mkha' spyod du byon par bsams la/ smon lam bya'o// rje btsun ma'i zhal gdams bla ma sa skya pa'i man ngag*// ༈ /nā ro mkha' spyod kyi gser yon dang bcas pa'i 'pho ba chig brgyud ma ni/ brgyud pa 'di pa'i lugs la yig cha med/ snyan brgyud kho na yin gsungs/ yig chung 'di rtsol ba drag po byas pas grwa pa 'dra ba'i lag nas rnyed pas phul yod/ dmigs pa sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi dang*/ rjes gsum ka tshang ma rang mi gda' bas/ snyan brgyud dag po yod nges cig la rtsad gcod gnang dgos pa gda' lags/ yig chung 'di 'dra'ang gzhan la mi gnang ba zhu/ ngor nas zhus/ yig chung 'di yi mchan bu 'di ngor pa chos rje kun dga' dbang phyug pa'i yin par 'dug nang so mtsho skyes pa'i drung du phul ba gnang ste/ brgyud pa 'di tshang gi man ngag gi phugs/ yig chung 'dis rtogs pa snang ngo*// zhes rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bsam mi khyab thun mong ma yin pa'i yig rnying ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gi phyag dpe'i gseb nas rnyed pa 'di yang*/

sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis snga mo'i dus su man ngag zab mo 'di'i khung gi yig rnying 'ga' zhig sa lo chen po'i phyag dpe'i khrod nas rnyed pa sogs 'di'i yig skor phyogs gcig tu sgrigs pa de'i gseb tshags su 'jug rgyur dmigs nas ngor chen gyi phyag dpe'i gseb nas dpe 'di rnyed 'phral yid dang 'dod kyi dad pa mchog dang ldan pas/ de ma thag tu bris pa'i dge bas chos med ā nan+da tshe 'di 'phos 'phral bar do med par mkha' spyod dbang mos lag pa'i mkhrig ma nas bzung ste dag pa mkha' spyod du thogs med du 'khrid par mdzad de/ bde ba can dang*/ dga' ldan/ mngon dga' sogs su phar 'gro tshur 'gro'i ngang nas sprul pas sa skya'i bstan pa dkar 'jams su bya nus pa'i mthu dang ldan par gyur cig don 'di thogs med du 'grub pa'i phrin las bka' srung rnams kyis kyang 'bad stsol drag pos sgrub par gyur cig de bzhin du 'gyur ba gcig chog rgyal po rje btsun mus pa chen pos byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ /thun mong ma yin pa'i bsam mi khyab kyi rnal 'byor mkha' spyod bsgrub pa'i nye lam bzhugs so// ༈ /rje btsun bla ma dang mus pa chen po'i zhabs la phyag bgyi'o// rjes su gzung du gsol/ thun mong ma yin pa'i bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ bzlas pa gnyis grub rjes/ chos 'byung bam̐ yig sogs nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba bzhin gyur/ rang nyid rnal 'byor ma phyi ltas nang gsal/ nang ltas phyi gsal/ kha dog dmar po nam mkha' la 'ja' shar ba bzhin snang la rang bzhin med par bsam pa'i lus kyi dbus na yar rtsa dbu ma chos bzhi ldan rta rnga ltar phra/ rgya skyegs ltar dmar/ chu shing ltar drang*/ til mar ltar gsal ba/ yas sna smin mtshams gnad kyi sgo nas spyi gtsug la byas/ mas sna lte ba'i 'khor lo la mtheb sor tsam ma reg pa/ g.yas su ro ma dmar mo gro sog tsam pa yar sna bug g.yas nas spyi bor la byas pa/

mas sna dbu ma las mtheb sor tsam gyis ring ba/ g.yon rkyang ma la yang des 'gre/ lte ba'i rtsa 'khor gyi dbus na bzhugs pa'i bam̐ yig de rnal 'byor ma rgyan cha lugs/ thugs kar chos 'byung bam̐ yig sogs dkyus bzhin la/ zhabs gnyis gshibs te brkyang pa'i spyi bor dbu ma zug pa/ ro rkyang gnyis sku'i g.yas g.yon nas zhabs kyi mthil du zug par bsam/ de nas rang sems dang rje btsun ma bam̐ yig dbyer med pa'i ngo bo lte ba'i rje btsun ma'i thugs ka'i bam̐ yig la sems cher gtad pas/ de las rje btsun sku che chung me stag lta bu'i rnam pa can chad/ sku lus g.yas phyogs nas zhabs g.yas pa'i nang nas mar song*/ ro ma'i sne mo zhabs mthil du zug pa la zhugs/ ro ma'i nang nas yar bya gnam 'phang bskyod pa bzhin gyen du song*/ sna bug g.yas nas bung ba tshang nas 'thon pa bzhin 'thon/ de las de 'dra ba'i rnal 'byor ma'i sku che chung bsam gyis mi khyab pa phyogs thams cad du khyab/ 'phags pa rnams la dgyes pa'i mchod pa sems can thams cad rnal 'byor mar gyur pa sogs mdor na snod bcud thams cad dag pa'i rang bzhin du byas/ 'od zer gyi rnam pa tshur bsdus/ sna bug g.yon nas rkyang ma'i lam brgyud rim gyis song ba zhabs kyi mthil nas yar byas rje btsun ma'i bam̐ yig la thim/ de lta bu rlung 'gro 'ong dang bstun pa'am/ mi bstun kyang lan ci mang sbyang*/ ma mtha'ang gsum tsam/ de nas bam̐ yig la sems cher gtad pas/ de las 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ rang rje btsun mar gsal ba'i sku'i smad kyi phyogs la phog pas/ 'od kyi rnam pas rje btsun ma'i sku'i phyogs la yar 'dus/ de bzhin du stod la song bas mar 'dus/ 'od dmar po rdza ma tsam du gyur/ de yang rje btsun ma la thim/ de nas rje btsun ma de nyid snying ga'i thad du sbar gyis byon pas ro rkyang gnyis kyang 'dus te/ zhabs la cung zad nar yod pa tsam/

de nas mgrin pa'i thad du spar gyis byon/ ro rkyang gnyis kyang lhag ma lus pa'i dus/ de man chad kyi dbu ma las sku ji ltar yar byon pa ltar 'dus/ de nas spyi bo'i thad du yar byon pas dbu ma'ang 'dus te/ rje btsun ma'i sku gcig pu rang sems dang dbyer med/ spyan gsum dag pa mkha' spyod du gzigs shing*/ der 'gro ba'i bzhed pa drag po dang ldan pa/ spyan gzigs lugs dang*/ thugs kyi bzhed pa'i dmigs pa 'di snying kha mgrin pa lte ba gsum la'ang dgos rgyu yin/ de dang de'i skabs su de dang de la sems gtad nas cung zad re 'jog go /de nas rje btsun ma mkha' spyod du gshegs pa de/ je mtho nas 'ja' yal ba bzhin spros med la ci gnas mnyam par bzhag de la mi gnas na/ mkha' spyod nas rje btsun ma slar rang nyid 'dug pa'i thad tsam du byon/ de'i rkyen gyis ro rkyang dbu ma rje btsun ma yang gsal btab/ sngar bzhin gyi dmigs pa rnams bya/ de 'dra ba lan ci mang bya'o// 'di la mkha' spyod bsgrub pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams pa/ nang gi rnal 'byor ma mkha' spyod kyi 'pho ba zhes bzhed do// ces pa 'di'ang sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis bla ma gong ma'i gsung rgyun zin bris rnams las legs par btus te brjed thor bris pa'o// ༈ /bde mchog yum rkyang gi 'pho ba chig brgyud gser chos kyi gdams pa mal lo tsā'i gsung la rje sa chen gyis zin bris mdzad pa'i nyams len gyi snying po bzhugs so// ༈ /dkon mchog la skyabs gzhan phyir 'pho ba bsgom// rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i// lus nang dbu ma'i mas snar chos 'byung nang*// rang sems bam̐ yig spyi bor chos 'byung nang*// seng khri pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng du// bla ma mkha' spyod dbang mor gsal ba la// rtsa brgyud bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems dang*// yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs rnams thim// phyi dang nang gi mchod cing bstod par bgyi// bla ma rnal 'byor ma la gsol ba 'debs// bdag 'dzin blo yis thongs par byin gyis rlobs// dgos med rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs// lam mchog 'pho ba 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs// 'khyug med mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// rang dbugs phyi la 'gro ba dang bstun nas// 'og rlung 'then pas lte ba'i rang gi sems// bam̐ yig gsal ba de las de 'dra ba// gcig chad dbu ma'i nang brgyud spyi bor nas// rgyang gis 'thon pa bla ma rnal 'byor ma'i// gsang bar zhugs nas thugs ka'i bam̐ la thim// rang dbugs nang 'jug dus su rang sems bam̐// mar la babs te dbu ma'i nang brgyud nas// sngar gyi lte ba'i bam̐ yig de la thim// spyi bo'i bla ma rnal 'byor ma de yang*// rang gi lte ba'i bam̐ la thim par gyur// tshul 'di bsgom pas rang gzhan mkha' spyod kyi// go 'phang thob nas don gnyis mthar phyin shog

/las sbyar dus gong gi tshigs gsang bar zhugs nas thugs ka'i bam̐ la thim zhes pa'i rjes su/ bar do med pa rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// gyur nas mkha' spyod gnas su gshegs par shog /ces brjod cing bsam la rang sems bam̐ yig mar mi 'beb pa yin/ zhes 'di'ang sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dgas bris// ༈ /shin tu zab pa'i gdams pa rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i 'pho ba chig brgyud ma bzhugs so// ༈ /bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la brten nas btsan thabs su 'pho ba'i man ngag ni/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa sngon du btang nas/ yi dam gyi lha la tshogs gtor phul/ slob ma rnams khrus legs par byas te/ slob ma'i spyi bor bla ma dang tha mi dad pa'i rnal 'byor ma gsal btab/ gus 'dud drag po'i sgo nas/ bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so// bdag 'dzin blo yis thongs par byin gyis rlobs// lam mchog 'pho ba 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs// 'khyug med mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsol ba btab/ slob ma'i lte bar chos 'byung gru gsum phyi dkar la nang dmar ba gcig gsal btab/ de'i nang du rang gi rnam par shes pa a dkar ba 'phur 'gro la khad cig gsal btab/ a de la zug pa'i rtsa dbu ma mda' smyug 'bring po tsam spyi bo nas yar song*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gsang gnas la zug par bsam/ dpon slob gnyis ka'i ngag tu phaṭa brjod pas rang gi thod pa phog ste mdun du dpral ba rang la bstan pa kha gyen du bstan la bzhag yang phaṭa brjod pas lte ba yan chad kyi lus thod pa'i nang du lhung bar bsam/ yang phaṭa gcig brjod pas thod pa'i rdzas de ye shes bdud rtsir byin gyis rlob par bsams nas/ rdo rje rnal 'byor mas gsol= de nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i thugs ka'i bam̐ yig las 'od kyi ba thag dkar po dbu ma'i nang nas skya nar byung*/

lte ba la gnas pa'i rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo a dkar po de la zug rlung phyir ldang ba dang bstun te/ ngag tu hika brjod pas/ a dkar po de 'od kyi sna la khyer te dbu ma'i nang nas song ste/ rnal 'byor ma'i thugs ka'i bam̐ yig la gnyis med du 'dres/ rlung nang du 'jug pa dang bstun/ ka zhes brjod pa dang bstun te/ thugs ka'i bam̐ yig las 'od kyi ba thag dang bcas pa byung ste/ lte ba'i chos 'byung gi nang du gnas/ de lta bu'i 'pho ba 'byongs pa'i rtags ma byung gi bar du sbyangs/ de nas lus po sngar bzhin med par song bar bsam/ las la sbyar dus yar spar mar 'bebs pa de mi byed do// dge ba 'di yis sogs smon lam btab/ bla ma dang mkha' spyod ma'i thugs dang rang sems dbyer med du 'dres/ rnal 'byor ma mkha' spyod du byon par bsam gsungs so// 'di'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bo dong paṇa chen phyogs las rnam rgyal/ ras chen dpal 'byor bzang po/ rje sems dpa' chen po'i dngos slob zhwa lu ba sangs rgyas dpal bzang*/ mkhas grub dam pa mnga' ris pa dpal ldan rgyal po/ snyan brgyud gdams pa'i mnga' bdag chos rje bzang po dpal ba/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dbang phyug rje btsun dam pa 'khor lo sdom pa chos dbang phyug rje de nyid kyi drung du 'dren pa dam pa mtshungs med rje btsun mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyis gsan/ rje btsun bka' drin can de la sa skya pa chos med ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis rmis ltas bzang po dang bcas nas gling kha bsam gtan phu'i rje bla ma'i gzim phug tu dges bzhin du gnang ba'i zab chos kun dang thun mong ma yin pa 'di snod min la dam du sba zhing*/ skal ldan dag la dam du spel bar bya'o// bla ma mkhyen/ bdag cag dpon slob rnams mkha' spyod du thogs med du skye bar khyed kyi mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi sgo nas byin gyis rlobs shig

/maṅga laṃ// ༈ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i 'pho ba chig brgyud ma'i dris lan dogs dpyod kyi zin bris bzhugs// ༈ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i 'pho ba chig brgyud ma bsgom par 'dod pas/ rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi bsam mi khyab pa'i rnal 'byor gyi mjug bde stong gi ngang nas skur langs te bsgom pa yin gsung ba/ spyir de skabs su rgyan dang phyag mtshan med par langs par bzhed par bzhin/ 'pho ba bsgom pa'i tshe yang sku rgyan med du langs pas chog gam/ rgyan bcas su lang dgos/ de'i tshe rang gi spyi bor bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma byams pa khyel bzhugs kyi rnam par bsgom pa'i gsang gnas la rang gi tshang bug nas 'thon pa'i rtsa dbu ma'i yas sna zug par bsgom par gsungs pa'i dbu ma de kha dog ji ltar du bsgom dgos/ rang gi rnam shes kyi ngo bo a bsam rgyu de chung yig tu bsam pa chog gam che yig tu bsam dgos/ phaṭa gsum dang*/ hika ka rnams skad che chung ji ltar bya/ rang gi lus lte ba yan chad mchod par phul ba'i lhag ma de mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang las/ 'pho ba bsgom grub 'phral rang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur langs nas/ oṃ ha na ma hi sogs dang*/ tshams rngam sngags kyis bsrung ba dang*/ hūm̐ gcig brjod pas sku'i dga' ba dang*/ rkang brgyad brjod pas gsung gi dga' ba/ yang hūm̐ gcig brjod pas thugs kyi dga' ba dang*/ de nas bsngo ba smon lam rnams byed par gsungs pas las sbyor gyi skabs ma yin pas da lta 'pho ba sbyong ba'i skabs rnams su/ rang gi spyi bor bsgom pa'i bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma de mi dmigs pa'am/ rang la thim par bsam/ de rnams la yid gnyis kyi drwa ba bcad du gsol/ zhes pa'i lan ni/ bla ma rnal 'byor ma rgyan can du bsgom dgos shing*/ rang rgyan yod med gang byas kyang chog la/ dbu ma phyi dkar la nang dmar ba bsgom rgyu yin zhing*/ phaṭa gsum dang hika ka gnyis rang gis tshor tsam chog la/

rnam shes kyi ngo bo a bsam rgyu de che yig yin zhing*/ 'pho ba sbyang dus kyi bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rang la bstim rgyu yin lags/ 'dis rab ni mkha' spyod chen po thob/ de ma thob na chung ngu nges par thob/ de'i yon tan ni lha'i lo bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can/ skra sil bur gnas pa/ rdzu 'phrul gyis nam mkha' la 'gro ba/ ci 'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad nam mkha' las 'byung ba/ tshe nyi zla nam gnas kyi bar du thub pa/ sprul sku las chos nyan nus pa/ tshe de la sangs rgyas nges pa zhig yin/ zhes pa 'di mus chen 'khor lo sdom pa'i gsung ji lta ba bzhin sa skya pa shākya'i dge slong a nan+das gling kha bsam gtan phug gi rje dam pa'i gzim phug mdor rje'i zhabs drung nyid du bris pa'o// sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ /rje btsun nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi nyams len snying po dril ba snyan rgyud gser gyi yang zhun zhes bya ba snod min la gsang ba'i chos so// ༈ /na mo badz+ra wā rā hi/ khyab bdag gar gyi dbang phyug rdo rje chos// ngur smrig gar gyis rol pa'i drin chen rje// pha rgod sku drin mtshungs med mkhyen rab mtshan// byang chub bar du snying dbus pad+mor bzhugs// de la 'dir bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras la thun mong ma yin pa'i gser chos bcu gsum yod pa'i nang nas jo bo nā ro ta pa nyid la rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nyid kyis dngos su gnang ba'i zab chos rje btsun nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i khrid kyi rnal 'byor nyams su len pa'i tshul la/ gang gis nyams su len pa'i gang zag ni/ rab bde mchog lū nag gang rung gi smin byed thob pa'am/ de ltar ma grub na kye rdor man ngag lugs lta bu'i dkyil 'khor du smin byed thob nas/ tshes bcu gnyis gang yang rung bar sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor du byin rlabs legs par thob nas chag med kyi rgyun dang ldan pas rab tshe 'di nyid la mkha' spyod 'grub/

'bring 'chi kha tha ma bar dor mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub 'grub par 'gyur zhing*/ de dag gi nyams len gyi gtso bo ni bskyed rim rnal 'byor bcu gcig po 'dir ma 'dus pa med pas/ rnal 'byor bcu gcig ni/ nyal dang ldang dang bdud rtsi myang*// tshad med bla ma bdag lhar bskyed// 'gro ba dag pa'i rnal 'byor dang*// dpa' bo dpa' mos byin gyis brlabs// ngag bzlas yid bzlas gnyis gcig yin// bsam gyis mi khyab rnal 'byor dang*// spyod lam gyi ni rnal 'byor te// de ltar rnal 'byor bcu gcig go /zhes pa ltar bcu gcig yod pa las/ dang po nyal ba'i rnal 'byor yin/ gnas khang gzhal yas khang*/ rang rje btsun ma phyag mtshan med pa'i skur gsal btab/ sngas mgor bla ma rdo rje chos bzhugs pa'i pang du mgo bzhag pa'i tshul du rnam rtog gzhan gyis bar ma chod par gnyid log par bya'o// de'i dgos pa'am sbyang gzhi snod kyi 'jig rten 'jig pa/ bcud kyi sems can 'chi ba/ dud 'gro bzhin du bag med du gnyid log par byed pa thams cad sbyong byed nyal ba'i rnal 'byor gyis sbyangs pas sbyangs 'bras chos sku thob par byed/ gnyis pa ldang ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ tho rangs nam gyi brgyad cha lon pa na nam mkha' nas oṃ gsum ma'i sngags sgra ḍā ma ru'i skad du yod pa'i mos pa dang ldan pa'i sgo nas chu las nya 'phar ba'i tshul du rang rje btsun ma phyag mtshan med pa'i skur ldang*/ de'i dgos pa'am sbyang gzhi ni snod kyi 'jig rten chags pa bcud kyi sems can skye ba 'phral gyi 'gro 'dug byed pa thams cad sbyong byed ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gyis sbyangs pas sbyangs 'bras longs sku thob par byed do// gsum pa bdud rtsi myang ba ni/ rab bdud rtsi ril bu bza' zhing med na bdud rtsi ril bu yod pa'i dmigs pas oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes myang bas/ snying ga'i bam̐ yig sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo mchod par bsam/

de'i dgos pa'am sbyang gzhi ni/ 'dod sred kyi bsam pas khrus byed pa dang*/ mu stegs byed la sogs pas lus la khrus byas pas sems kyi sdig pa 'dag pa'i chos su 'dod pa dang*/ 'dul ba las khrus dang gtsang sbra bya ba sogs nyams len gyis ma zin pa thams cad sbyong byed bdud rtsi myang ba'i rnal 'byor gyis sbyangs 'bras sprul sku thob par byed do// bzhi pa tshad med ces pas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed gnyis ka bstan pas/ spyir skyabs 'gro la theg pa che chung dang grub mtha' gong 'og gi 'dod tshul mi 'dra ba mang du yod kyang 'dir kun 'dus nor bu lugs su bsgom ste/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar seng khri pad+ma'i gdan la bla ma dang tha mi dad pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje chos rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i sku dge 'dun/ gsum dam chos/ thugs sangs rgyas/ yon tan nor lha/ phrin las chos skyong ste skyabs gnas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor gyur par bsams la/ skyabs 'gro bzhi skor tshar gang mang brjod/ mthar bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas de gdan seng khri nas yar/ dbu'i gtsug tor nas mar thugs ka'i thad du 'od dmar po'i rnam par zhu nas/ rang gi smin mtshams su thim pas rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dang*/ skyabs yul gyi sku gsung thugs dbyer med du gyur par bsam pa'i ngang la ci nus mnyam par bzhag pa ni don dam gyi skyabs 'gro yin no// de nas sems bskyed ni ma gyur nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i ched du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bsgom par bgyi'o snyam pa'i sgo nas jo bo nā ro ta pa'i bzhed pa ltar/

bdag gis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zhes sogs tshar gsum brjod/ lnga pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ lam thams cad bla ma la brten nas bgrod dgos pas/ rang gi nam mkhar gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis mdzes pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du rin po che'i khri'i steng du rtsa ba'i bla ma sangs rgyas rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can la mdun nas g.yon skor du brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dpa' bo rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa 'ba' zhig gis bskor ba mngon sum lta bur bzhugs par bsams la/ tshogs bsags pa'i phyir du maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun ma so bdun ma sogs ji ltar rigs pa dbul zhing ma grub kyang chad pa'i skyon mi 'byung*/ de nas brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs sogs kyang ci shes bya/ rang gi snying ga nas rang sems rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mthe bong tsam zhig spyi gtsug nas 'thon/ rang gi lus tsho zhing snum pa khrig ge 'dug pa la gzigs nas phyag gri gug gis thod pa la reg pas ling gis thod pa'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du bkal/ de nas rang gi yan lag thams cad dum bur gtubs te thod pa'i nang du bskyur te oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥlan gsum gyis bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsams la/ thugs ka nas mchod pa'i lha mo thod pa thogs pa dpag tu med pa 'phros te thod pa'i bdud rtsi nas bcus te/ thog mar rtsa ba'i bla ma la lan gsum phul/ de nas brgyud pa'i bla ma la lan gsum/ mthar drin chen rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la gsol ba 'debs so// bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la dbang bzhi bskur mi bskur gyi gnang ba nod pa'i phyir spyan kho ro ro gzigs pas/ mas nas rim gyis zhu nas rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim pas bla ma de la sangs rgyas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor gyur par bsam/

dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so// bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas bla ma'i dpral ba'i oṃ las 'od zer dkar po dang oṃ yig gi phreng ba dpag tu med pa byung rang gi dpral ba nas zhugs/ bum pa'i dbang thob lus kyi dri ma dag bla ma'i mgrin pa'i āḥlas 'od zer dmar po dang āḥyig gi phreng ba dpag tu med pa byung*/ rang gi mgrin pa nas zhugs/ gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag bla ma'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer sngon po dang hūm̐ yig gi phreng ba dpag tu med pa byung rang gi snying kha nas zhugs/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ sems kyi dri ma dag bla ma'i gnas gsum las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum gyi phreng ba dpag tu med pa byung*/ rang gi dpral mgrin snying ga gsum du zhugs dbang bzhi pa thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa dag mthar bla ma de 'od dmar po bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du mer gyis zhu/ rang gi smin mtshams nas zhugs/ lus kyi nang thams cad 'od dmar po des khyab pas sgo gsum gyi sdig sgrib bag chags sbyangs rang lus 'od dmar ser li khri'i mdog can bam̐ yig tu gyur par bsam/ de'i ngang las drug pa lhar bskyed pa ni bam̐ yig de yongs su gyur pa las pad+ma nyi ma 'jigs byed dus mtshan dang bcas pa'i gdan bsams la/ de yang rnal 'byor pa 'khor bar gnas kyang 'khor ba'i rnam rtog gis ma gos brdar pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ bde chen gyi ye shes gong 'phel gyi brdar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ 'dod chags kyi rnam rtog 'joms pa'i brdar dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i chags pa'i gnas nu ma gnyis kyi bar du zhabs g.yas dang*/ zhe sdang gi rnam rtog 'joms pa'i brdar 'jigs byed nag po'i zhe sdang gi gnas snying ga'i thad du/ gti mug gi rnam rtog 'joms pa'i brdar gti mug gi gnas mgo bo rgyab tu bltab nas zhabs g.yon gyis mnan pa/

de lta bu'i gdan gyi steng du rang nyid kyi ma dag pa'i phung khams skye mched thams cad sbyangs nas dag par rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma stong gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin can sems can gyi don la rjes su chags pas sku mdog dmar ba'i me lta bu'i gzi brjid can/ chos thams cad de bzhin nyid du ro gcig pas zhal gcig pa/ bden pa gnyis thugs su chud pas phyag gnyis pa/ dus gsum sgrib med du gzigs pa spyan gsum pa/ mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub brnyes pas mkha' spyod gzigs pa/ 'khor 'das kyi mtha' gnyis spangs pas zhabs gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rje phyed pas yu ba byas pa'i gri gug 'og 'khor ba'i phyogs su brkyang nas 'jol thabs su 'dzin pas 'khor ba'i rnam rtog gcod pa mtshon pa/ phyag g.yon zla ba ltar dkar ba'i thod par bdud bzhi'i khrag gis gang ba steng phyogs su bzung nas zhal gyen du phyogs pas gsol ba/ bde chen gyi ye shes rgyud la skye ba mtshon pa/ phrag pa g.yon par thabs bde ba chen po dang mi 'bral bar mtshon pa'i brdar kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dkar po yu ba brgyad gzhogs lus tshad dang mnyam pa'i sne rdo rje phyed pas mtshan pa'i steng du phrin las rnam bzhis sems can gyi don mdzad pa mtshon pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje phyogs mdog can/ de'i steng du dbang bzhi'i chu rgyun mi nub pa mtshon byed bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba/ de'i steng du sku gsum rang chas su mtshon pa'i thod skam dkar dmar sngo gsum brtsegs pa/ de'i steng du zung 'jug bde ba chen po mtshon pa'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa dgang pos brgyan pa/ bde stong gi sgra rgyun mi chad pa sgrog pa'i ḍā ma ru dang dril bu dang 'phan rtse gsum pa 'phyang bzhin pa phrag pa g.yon du bkal thabs su bsnams pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga mtshon pa'i thod pa skam po lnga rtse phran dang bcas pa'i dbu rgyan dang*/ nang gi kā li lnga bcu dag pa'i brdar thod pa lnga bcu'i do shal/

rus pa'i rgyan phreng zhes pa spyi bor rus pa'i 'khor lo/ snyan rgyan mgul rgyan gdu bu ske rags dang bcas pa/ gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa las grol ba mtshon byed dbu skra nag snum ma 'dzings shing ma bcings pas sku sked yan chad sil le khyab pa/ sku las skyes pa'i ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de yang thang sku lta bu'i bcar mo dang lder sku lta bu'i 'bi mo ma yin pa/ phyi bltas na nang gsal nang bltas phyi gsal ba gsal stong 'od kyi rang bzhin can du bsgom/ de nas lus dkyil bskyed na rang rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i snying khar chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi dbus su srog gi a thung gi ngo bo yi ge bam̐ gyi yi ge kha 'phral ba/ dbus su bam̐/

dmar/ shar du chu'i rang bzhin wa/ dkar/ byang du rlung gi rang bzhin ya/ ljang*/ /nub tu me yi rang bzhin ra/ dmar/ lhor sa'i rang bzhin la/ ser/ rnams rang rang gi kha dog dang mthun pa'i rnal 'byor ma lnga/ mtha' skor yi ge so gnyis su se ba/ rnal 'byor ma so gnyis su gyur par bsgom/ phyi nang gi lha rnams kyi gnas rnams su ngo bo lha la rnam pa yig 'bru'i gzugs su zla ba'i gdan re re'i steng du lte bar rdo rje phag mo'i ngo bo oṃ bam̐ dmar mo/ snying khar ham̐ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hriṃ moṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral bar hriṃ hriṃ ser mo skyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang gu skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i ngo bor me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bu bsgom/ bdun pa 'gro ba dag pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang gi snying kha'i lus dkyil kyi gtso mo'i thugs ka'i bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer kha dog lnga ldan bun gyis 'phros/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas phar brtan g.yo snod bcud thams cad la phog pas gzhal yas khang dang bcud rigs drug bar do bcas pa'i sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa sbyangs nas thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur par bsam/ 'o na 'gro ba gzhan rnams la de ltar nus sam zhe na/ shin tu nus te snang ba thams cad sems kyi cho 'phrul yin pa'i phyir ro// brgyad pa dpa' bo dpa' mos byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ mngon rtogs nas 'byung pa ltar phaiṃ zhes ngo mtshar sgyu ma'i phyag rgya dang bcas brjod/ sems kyi dmigs pa ni snying ga'i bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros 'og min na bzhugs pa'i lhan skyes longs spyod rdzogs sku'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yul so bdun gnas nyer bzhi sogs nas zhing skyes sprul pa'i sku ma mkha' 'gro ma yin pa'i bu mor skyes pa rigs las skyes pa/

rang nyid kyi sngar sbyangs pa'i 'gro ba rnal 'byor mar gyur pa ni sngags las skyes pa ste/ de lta bu'i pho nya rnams la phog pas thugs rgyud bskul nas steng nas byon pa rnams kha ba bu yug 'tshubs pa lta bu/ 'og nas byon pa rnams dbyar gyis rlangs rdol ba lta bu long long*/ bar nas byon pa rnams dge 'dun mang po chos 'khor la 'du ba ltar 'ur dir byon/ rang rje btsun mar gsal ba la bye ma la chu sib pa ltar gnyis su med par bsam/ de nas rang tha mal pa mi yang ma yin te skyon kun zad cing yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nga yin snyam pa'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ oṃ yo ga shud+dha sogs 'khyud rgya dang bcas pa brjod/ dgu pa bzlas pa la ngag bzlas yid bzlas gnyis las dang po ngag bzlas ni/ lus dkyil bsgoms na lus dkyil kyi gtso mo'i thugs ka dang*/ ma bsgoms na rang rje btsun mar gsal ba'i thugs kar chos 'byung nyis brtsegs/ de steng du zla ba la bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ rigs drug bar dor bcas pa'i sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa thams cad sbyangs 'od zer tshur 'dus snying ga'i sngags phreng la thim par bsams nas lag pa g.yon pas rab thod phreng brgya rtsa brgyad dam yang na bo dhi rtse brgya rtsa brgyad bzung nas myur bul ran par oṃ gsum ma brgya stong sogs nas dam bca' la nyung mtha' byas pas bzlas/ 'di ni gtso bor bzlas bsgom la brten nas mkha' spyod sgrub pa yin pas nges par bzlas brjod la brtson par bya'o// gnyis pa yid bzlas ni/ thog mar rlung ro sna bug g.yas nas bus/ de nas g.yon nas/ de nas gnyis ka nas bus la dbugs ngal gso/ de nas thog mar 'og rlung 'then/ de nas steng rlung chil gyis mnan pa dang dus mnyam du mchil ma zhig mid pas snying ga'i chos 'byung zla ba sngags phreng dang bcas pa lte ba'i thad du sdigs kyis bskyur/

'og rlung dang steng rlung gnyis ka rdzogs par 'then/ rlung bum pa can 'dzin pa'i dus su yid kyis sngags phreng klog pa'i tshul du oṃ gsum ma ci thub 'dren/ mi thub na rlung sna bug nas sir gyis btang*/ 'di ni spros bcas kyi rdzogs rim du 'gyur bar gsungs pas spro zhing long yod na lan 'ga' zhig bskyar/ slar yang zhar byung gi rdzogs rim bde stong sgrub pa'i dmigs pa ni/ rang rje btsun mar gsal ba'i lte bar chos 'byung nyis brtsegs mdun rgyab spangs pa'i grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil pa g.yon skor du dmar khyi ri ri 'khor ba dang*/ gsang gnas su dga' 'khyil dmar po g.yon skor du 'khor ba dang*/ smin mtshams dga' 'khyil dkar po g.yon skor du 'khor ba la dmigs nas rlung bum can bzung zhing*/ bde ba'i ye shes skye bar 'dod na gsang gnas kyi dga' 'khyil la dmigs pa drag tu gtad de/ bde ba ches nas mi bzod pa byung na stong pa'i ye shes skye ba'i phyir du smin mtshams kyi dga' ba 'khyil pa la dmigs pa drag tu gtad/ 'di yun ring du bsgoms na du ba la sogs pa'i rtags rnams rim par 'byung bar 'gyur ro// yang rdzogs rim gnyis pa bsgom par 'dod pas rang rje btsun mar gsal ba'i lus kyi dbus drang por rtsa dbu ma chos bzhi ldan sba lcag 'bring po tsam drang thal le yod pa/ mas sne dga' 'khyil mtshal lcog las bris pa lta bur rtsa dbu ma la reg la ma 'byar ba g.yon skor du dmar kyi ri ri 'khor ba/ yas sne dga' 'khyil shel dkar gyi khu bas bris pa lta bu g.yon skor du dkar kyi ri ri 'khor ba la dmigs nas/ thog mar mas rlung 'then pas mas kyi dga' 'khyil rgya mthongs nas bya phur ba ltar rtsa dbu ma'i nang brgyud snying ga'i thad du g.yon skor du shugs drag tu 'khor bar dmigs pa gtad pas snang ba thams cad bde cham cham gyur snang ba mched pa'i lam sbyangs/ de nas steng rlung chil gyis mnan pas yas sna'i dga' 'khyil rgya mthongs nas bya 'phur ba ltar thur du babs/

snying ga'i thad du g.yon skor du shugs drag tu 'khor bar dmigs pa gtad pas snang ba thams cad stong cham cham gyur snang ba thob pa'i lam sbyangs/ de nas rlung bum can 'dzin pa'i dus su snying ga'i dga' 'khyil gnyis reg la ma 'byar tsam du 'khor zhing dga' 'khyil gnyis phrug chil gyis 'dres pas dga' 'khyil dmar skya g.yon skor du drag tu 'khor ba la sems gtad/ mthar dga' 'khyil dbu ma la thim/ dbu ma yang 'ja' yal ba ltar gyur par bsams la/ rlung sna bug nas dal bus btang*/ 'di bsgoms pas bde stong lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rgyud la skye zhing*/ snang ba nyer thob sbyong bar byed pas da lta nas 'bad pas bsgom par bya'o// gsungs so// bcu pa bsam mi khyab kyi rnal 'byor la thun mong ba mngon rtogs kyi dkyus ltar dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa gser chos chig brgyud ma gnyis las/ 'dir phyi ma nyams su len par byed pa la/ thun bsdu ba'i tshe rang rje btsun mar bsgom pa'i lus kyi dbus drang por rtsa dbu ma chos bzhi ldan yar sne spyi gtsug tu he re yod pa mas sne lte ba'i thad du yod cing sbom phra sba lcag tsam pa/ g.yas su ro ma dmar mo mas sne lte ba'i thad du dbu ma dang sbubs gcig tu yod pa/ yas sne spyi gtsug nas sba gug pa ltar gug pa sna bug g.yas su ha re yod pa/ g.yon du rkyang ma dkar mo mas sne dbu ma dang sbubs gcig pa lte bar sleb pa/ yas sne spyi gtsug nas sba gug pa ltar sna bug g.yon du ha re yod pa rnams gsal btab/ lte ba'i rtsa sbubs gcig tu rang sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mtheb sor gyi tshad tsam mkha' spyod du 'byon par rings pa zhig gsal btab/ de nas lam sbyang ba'i phyir rlung sna bug g.yas nas phyir rgyu ba'i dus su lte ba'i rnal 'byor ma de las rnal 'byor ma chung ngu zhig me stag yar ba ltar g.yas ro ma'i nang nas dmar khyug khyug byon/

sna bug g.yas kyi sgor sleb pa dang de las de 'dra ba'i rnal 'byor ma bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la mchod par byas/ rigs drug bar do bcas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal sbyangs/ de thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur pa gcig la gcig thim pa'i tshul gyis rnal 'byor ma de nyid la thim/ de sna bug g.yon pa'i sgo nas zhugs g.yon rkyang ma'i nang nas mar dmar khyug khyug byon/ lte ba'i rnal 'byor ma de nyid la thim par mos pa ni thog mar rtsa lam sbyangs pa ste/ long yod na lan kha yar bya zhing mkha' spyod sgrub pa dngos ni/ lte ba'i mkha' spyod ma de yar dbu ma'i nang du rgyangs rgyangs byon pas rtsa ro rkyang gnyis kyang zhabs la 'byar ba'i tshul gyis je thung du gyur/ phyi'i sku lus kyi lte ba man chad kyang nang gi rnal 'byor ma de nyid la thim/ de snying ga'i thad du byon pa dang snying ga man chad kyi phyi'i lus nang gi rtsa gsum dang bcas pa de nyid la thim/ de mgrin par byon pa'i tshe mgrin pa man cha da kyi phyi nang gi lus rtsa dang bcas pa de nyid la thim/ rnal 'byor ma de spyi gtsug tu rgyangs kyi byon pa'i tshe lus ril po rtsa gsum dang bcas pa rnal 'byor ma chung ngu de nyid la thim pas lus kyi shul bug pa ha re yod par bsam/ rnal 'byor ma de me stag yal ba'am rtsal po ches mda' 'phangs pa ltar mkha' spyod du yer gyis gshegs par bsams nas 'dzin med kyi ngang du ci nus bzhag de nas long khom yod na rtsa gsum sogs sngar ltar grub par mos nas sngar bzhin mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i dmigs pa de yang yang bskyar/ long med na lus sngar bzhin rdo rje rnal 'byor ma de'i nga rgyal gyi sgo nas spyod lam la 'jug go /bcu gcig pa spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor la dngos dang 'phros don gnyis las/ dang po ni rang dang snang ba thams cad rdo rje'i rnal 'byor mar bsgom pa ni sku'i dag pa/

sgra ci grags pa thams cad oṃ gsum ma'i sgrar bsgom pa gsung gi dag pa/ sems kyi yul du bzang ngan gyi rtog pa gang shar yang gsal stong 'dzin med spros bral gyi ngang du 'jog pa ni thugs kyi dag pa/ gzhung gzhan nas 'khyer so gsum gsungs pa yang gnad gcig go /kha zas bza' btung gang byed kyang oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs nas/ snying ga'i bam̐ yig sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo mchod par bsam pas longs spyod/ de bzhin du gos gyon pa'i tshe yang 'bru gsum brjod pas lha rdzas kyi gos pañtsa li kar mos pas longs spyod na bu lon mi 'gyur zhing tshogs rdzogs par 'gyur zhes gsungs/ gnyis pa 'phros don la thun mtshams su gtor ma 'bul ba'i tshul ni/ dku bag dang 'brel ba'i gtor ma zlum po dkar po pad 'dab bzhis bskor ba rgyan ldan zhig bshams/ nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs la byin gyis rlabs pa dang 'bul tshul sogs mngon rtogs nas 'byung ba ltar bya'o// de nas bsnyen pa/ sbyin sreg mar me'i sbyin sreg rnams bya tshul rnams gong ma'i yi ge ltar shes par bya'o// 'di lta bu'i nyams len chig dril du brtson par byas na dbang po rab bskal ldan rnams tshe 'di nyid la lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod du 'khrid par byed/ 'bring 'chi kha/ tha ma la bar do/ yang mtha' skye ba bdun nam bcu drug tshun du nges par mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas su bgrod pa ni nges pa yang dag pa'o// gal te nyams len ji lta ba bzhin ma grub na laṅka li ya'i shing la brten nas mkha' spyod bsgrub par bya dgos pas/ de'i tshul ni khrid yig chen mo las 'byung ba ltar bya'o// gzhan yang 'khor lo bde mchog rgyud las/ tshes bcu la ni de rab mchod// zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar tshogs bsog par 'dod na yar ngo*/ sdig pa sbyong bar 'dod na mar ngo'i tshes bcu gang rung la/ rab tshar chen rdo rje 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i mkha' spyod bsgrub pa'i dga' ston las ji ltar 'byung ba ltar tshes bcu'i mchod pa rgyas par bya ba'am/

de tsam ma grub na oṃ gsum ma dam bca'i grangs nyis 'gyur du bya ba dang*/ bu mo gzhon nu grong pa'i chos kyis ma gos pa lnga drug sogs bza' btung gis tshim par bya ba sogs nyams su blang bar bya'o// de rnams ji lta ba bzhin ma grub pa'am nyams len zhan pas mi 'dra na 'chi khar 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor nyams su len dgos pas/ 'di la rje btsun yab dang thun mong ba dang*/ yum dang thun mong ma yin pa/ yab yum zhal sbyor gyi 'pho ba gsum las/ 'dir shin tu zab pa yab yum gyi 'pho ba la/ sbyang ba dang*/ las la sbyar ba gnyis las/ dang po ni rnal 'byor ma'i bskyed rim dang 'brel ba'am ma 'brel kyang rung*/ rang lhar gsal btab pa'i lus kyi dbus drang por rtsa dbu ma chos bzhi ldan rag dung mgo mjug ldog pa lta bu yar sne spyi gtsug tu rgya mthongs lta bu ha re yod pa/ mar sne lte ba'i thad du yod pa'i sgo mtshams zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyis bkag pa/ de'i steng du rang sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mkha' spyod du 'byon par rings pa lta bu 'phar la khad phir la khad cig gsal btab/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar dkyil 'khor gyi rtsa ba'i bla ma 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang pas 'jigs byed dus mtshan ma mnan pa/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbu brgyan cing rlon pa lnga bcus do shal dang rus pa'i rgyan drug gis spras pa/ bdag la zhal phyogs te bzhugs pa la/ mkha' spyod kyi dpa' bo dang rig 'dzin gyis bskor ba mngon sum lta bur bzhugs par bsams la/ de la yid kyis mchod pa ci 'byor par 'bul la/ mos gus drag pos gdang dang bcas pa'am med kyang rung ste/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so// bdag 'dzin blo yis thongs par byin gyis rlobs// dgos med rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs// lam mchog 'pho ba 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs// 'khyugs med mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// zhes lan gsum la sogs par gsol ba btab/

sngar gyi dmigs pa de legs par gsal btab la/ a'i zhes dal bus drangs pa'i tshe rang sems rdo rje rnal 'byor ma de rtsa dbu ma'i nang nas yar rgyangs rgyangs byon/ mgrin pa'i thad du sleb pa'i tshe hika drag tu brjod pas bla ma'i thugs kar drag tu 'phos/ ka zhes sngar gyi lte ba'i thad du zla gdan la gnas par bsam pa de lta bu'i dmigs pa ma yengs par zhag bdun gsum sogs ci rigs pa'i bar du sbyangs/ 'byongs pa'i rtags spyi bo na ba dang za zhing chu ser 'dzag pa dang skrang ba la sogs 'byung zhing*/ 'byongs par mgo bor lag pa mi reg thun bsdu ba'i tshe spyi bo'i bla ma mar tshangs bug nas dbu ma'i nang du byon snying ga'i thad du zhugs/ rje btsun ma yar byon te zhal sbyor du bzhugs par bsgom/ gnyis pa las la sbyar ba la/ rang nyid phyi nang gsang ba'i 'chi ltas rnams byung ba'i tshe tshogs gsog pa dang tshe sgrub sogs la 'bad/ de ltar byas kyang ma ldog par nges par 'chi ba'i dus la babs pa'i tshe/ dper na bya nam mkha' la 'phur ba lag par rdo btags na 'phur mi thub pa ltar yo byad la chags na 'pho ba mi thebs pas gang la'ang chags zhen mi bya bar dngos po rnams bla ma dang dkon mchog gi phyogs su btang nas 'dzin pa med par bya/ de nas gnad gcod drag po ma byung na cung zad tsog pur 'dug la sngar gyi dmigs pa ma yengs par tshar gsum sogs gsal btab/ gsol 'debs mjug tu hika drag po brjod pas bla ma'i thugs kar rgyangs rgyangs kyis 'phos/ bla ma de dag pa mkha' spyod du gshegs par bsam pa'i dmigs pa gsum tsam gyis nges par theb par 'gyur ro// gsol 'debs lam mchog 'pho ba thebs par byin gyis rlobs zhes 'don pa bsgyur/ yang zug rngu drag pos mnar ba sogs gnad gcod mi bde na bla ma'am grogs dam tshig pa lta bus shub bus bskyar bas 'grub/ gang ltar yang 'ja' 'od dang me tog dang sin+dhu ra'i char sogs rtags khyad par can 'byung bas yid gnyis spangs te rtse gcig tu nyams su blang bar bya'o// smras pa/

dbang po rab rnams lus 'di mkha' spyod bgrod// 'bring gis 'chi kha tha mas bar do ru// nges par mkha' spyod bsgrub pa'i nyams len 'di// sa skya bla chen brgyud pa'i gser chos yin// de 'dra rgyal ba kun dngos rdo rje 'chang*// pha rgod mkhyen rab bla ma'i bka' 'bangs pas// dam pa'i bzhed pa bskang phyir bla ma'i gsung*// dbri bsnan spangs te dben pa'i gnas su bkod// dge des slob bshad zab mo'i ring lugs 'di// srid mtha'i bar du mi nyams rab 'phel zhing*// mtshungs bral dam pa'i bzhed dgongs mthar phyin te// rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub pa'i rgyu ru bsngo'o// zhes pa 'di yang mkhan rin po che blo bzang chos grags kyi bka' dwang du blangs te mkhyen rab bla ma'i bka' 'bangs lhun grub kyis dben nas rmor dgon par bris pa'o// ༈ /slob bshad 'dzin mkhas mkhas grub tshogs rnams la// mi phyed dang bas kun nas phyag 'tshal te// shin tu zab pa'i man ngag dbu ma'i lam// blo gsal rnams la phan phyir mdor bsdus bri// dpal ldan sa skya pa'i man ngag rje btsun nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i rtsa dbu ma nyams su len pa'i tshul la/ dpe gsum gyis don gcig bstan pa ste/ bshan pa srog gi gnad la mkhas pa/ shing mkhan shing gi gnad la mkhas pa/ sgyu ma mkhan 'khrul 'khor gyi gnad la mkhas pa gsum gyi sgo nas rnal 'byor pa lam gyi gnad la mkhas pa'i man ngag ni/ rgyas par khrid yig chen mo nas bshad pa ltar yin la/ 'dir de'i don bsdus te nyams su len na rtsa dbu ma kha dbye ba'i man ngag dang*/ dbye nas bsgom pa'i man ngag gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rang rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i lus kyi dbus drang por rtsa dbu ma mar sne lte 'og sor bzhir sleb pa/ g.yas su ro ma dmar mo gro sog 'bring po tsam pa yar sne spyi gtsug nas gug ste sna bug g.yas su ha re yod pa/ g.yon du rkyang ma dkar mo gro sog 'bring po tsam yar sne spyi gtsug tu gug ste sna bug g.yon du ha re yod pa/

mar sne lte ba'i thad du sbubs gcig tu gyur pa sbubs stong de'i nang du raṃ dmar po me'i rang bzhin du 'bar la khad pa/ de'i 'og tu rlung gi dkyil 'khor ljang nag sran ma bkas pa tsam gsal btab/ 'og rlung bskum pa'i rkyen gyis rlung g.yos des raṃ mer sbubs stong nang thams cad mer khengs/ de nas rtsa gsum rtsa phran dang bcas pa'i nang thams cad mes khengs pas sdig sgrib bag chags ngo bo snyigs ma thams cad cham cham bsregs/ spyi gtsug gi haṃ nas bdud rtsi babs pas bsregs pa'i shul thams cad dwangs ma dngul chu lta bus mer gyis khengs pa la dmigs pa gtad de rlung bum can 'dzin pa'o// gnyis pa bsgoms pa'i man ngag la rlung lus la gnas pas bde ba sgrub pa dang*/ sems la gnas pas stong pa sgrub pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ re zhig ro rkyang gnyis cam ste bzhag rang gi lus kyi drang por rtsa dbu ma sba lcag 'bring po tsam yar sne spyi gtsug nas gug ste smin mtshams su ha re yod pa/ de'i nang du 'od kyi rang bzhin chos 'byung dmar seng nge ba gdeng ka che ba phyir bstan cing*/ rtsa ba phra ba dbu ma'i nang du zug pa la bug pa rta rnga shong ba tsam yod pa/ mar sne gsang gnas su ha re yod pa'i chos 'byung gong dang 'dra ba gsal btab/ smin mtshams kyi chos 'byung gi nang du rang sems kyi ngo bo thig le kha dog lnga ldan 'od phrom phrom pa sran ma tsam zhig gsal btab/ 'og rlung cung zhig 'then steng rlung cung zhig mnan pa'i rkyen gyis smin mtshams kyi thig le de las 'od zer dpag tu med par 'phro bar gsal btab ste yun ring du bsgoms pas smin mtshams na lhang lhang 'byung*/ de nas thig le de bug pa nas yar song spyi gtsug gi thad du slebs pa'i tshe ri rtser skar ma shar ba lta bur gyur/ de nas dbu ma'i nang nas mar hril gyis babs bug pa nas thon chos 'byung gi nang du dmar hril li li yod pa la dmigs pa gtad pas bde ba'i ye shes dpag tu med pa skye bar 'gyur/

de la bde ba ches na yar spos smin mtshams su bsgom/ de lta bu yar spo mar spo'i tshul gyis ji tsam nus pa bsgom/ gnyis pa rlung sems la gnas pas stong pa bsgrub pa ni/ yang rtsa dbu ma'i yas sne spyi gtsug tu ha re yod pa la sems gtad de yas sne'i nang der 'ja' 'od kyi rang bzhin 'od lnga ldan gyi thig le mthe'u chung gi tshad tsam zhig yod par bsam/ de la 'od zer 'ja' tshon lta bu dbu ma'i nang nas 'od 'phros des gang reg pa'i rtsa khams thams cad 'ja' tshon du bun bun gyur/ de nas lus ril bur gnas khang lung pa yul khams/ nus na stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad 'ja' tshon 'ba' zhig tu gyur/ de la goms pa brtan mi brtan brtag pa'i phyir du thog mar dgun yin na shin tu grang ba'i sar 'dug pas grang ba'i reg bya mi mngon par bde ba 'ba' zhig tu 'char ba dang*/ dbyar gyi dus shin tu tsha ba'i gnas su 'dug kyang tsha ba'i reg bya mi 'byung bar bde ba 'ba' zhig tu 'char na grogs kyis dbyug pa lta bus ha cang na bar min pa brdung pas bde ba'i ye shes skye ba 'byung*/ de nas mtshon la sogs pas bsnun kyang nam mkha' la g.yug pa lta bu 'dug na spyod pa rnams rim gyis spyad/ nye rgyus mtshams sbyar nas zhag bdun nas kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan gyi go 'phang thob par 'gyur pa ni nges la yang dag pa'o// mdo rgyud kun gyi snying po'i bcud// gsang chen dbu ma'i man ngag lam// zab mo nyung ngu'i ngag gis bkod// dge des bstan pa dar gyur cig /ces rang gis sngar zin bris bgyis pa'i snyan brgyud gser gyi yang zhun gyi kha bskang dbu ma'i man ngag 'di lta bu dgos zhes don gnyer gyi slob bu bka' bcu kun dga' bsam 'grub la sogs pa du mas yang yang bskul ngor bya bral lhun grub kyis bkra shis chos sde'i bla brang du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa yang bskul ba po nyid do// maṅga laṃ//
